info.name: Jumbo App API (com.icemobile.jumboclient)
info.description:
Extracted from Jumbo mobile app (com.icemobile.jumboclient). GraphQL router and REST proxies.
Set base_url and token (Auth0 bearer).

body.raw:
{
  "query": "query GetCustomerPromotions {
  getCustomerPromotions {
    id
    active
    canBeRedeemed
    description
    employeePromotion
    externalId
    expirationDate
    extraMoneyAmount
    image
    incentiveVersion
    minimumSpent
    percentageDiscount
    eurosDiscount
    startDate
    packingState
    personalizedEndDate
    personalizedStartDate
    spendType
    startDate
    title
    localState @client {
      tag {
        text
        type
        stack
      }
    }
  }
}",
  "operationName": "GetCustomerPromotions"
}

    "shippingCosts": "<value>",
    "products": "<value>",

  }
}
